target_customer: Marketplaces, agencies and startups that pay contractors, creators and vendors across borders
problem: Cross border payouts are slow and expensive. Consul lets businesses pay in USDC stablecoins and recipients claim by email without needing a crypto wallet.
business_model: Payments platform with fees on stablecoin payouts via API, plus consumer account and card features

founders.name: David Lalor
education: Stanford, computer science and economics, dropped out
previous_startups: Virra (started at 16, about 500K dollars annual revenue)
founders.background_notes: Grew up in a small village in Ireland per YC bio.

founders.name: Rakeeb Hossain
education: University of Waterloo, computer science and math

technical_complexity.rationale: Stablecoin rails and wallets were available as infrastructure in 2024, but money transmission, KYC and compliance made a payouts product harder than ordinary software.

defensibility.rationale: Registration as a money services business with FinCEN is a modest barrier, but larger payment firms could offer the same rails.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe entered stablecoin payouts later in 2024 and 2025, after the batch. No source says who acquired Consul.

market_need_then: Freelancers and marketplaces pay high fees for cross border payouts, and stablecoin volumes were rising in 2023 and 2024. No Consul specific demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses onconsul.com, a prefix variant, rather than consul.com.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand was found. The name collides with HashiCorp Consul and the legal entity name is different.

outcome_analysis: Consul built a stablecoin payouts API from a two founder team in the Winter 2024 batch and registered as a money services business. YC marks it Acquired, but the live site presents it as an independent company under the legal name Swift Finance, Inc., and no acquirer, date or price turned up in searches. The outcome is therefore unconfirmed, and no funding beyond the YC deal is public.
notes: Conflict: YC status Acquired versus a live site with no mention of an acquisition and a 'Backed by Y Combinator' footer. The funding search found no round amounts. Competitor search found Stripe and Bridge, Remote and Stripe (Dec 2024) and others, all after the Winter 2024 founding or undated, so none are listed.
